messages:
lee: pushed a follow-up with the requested changes to routing fallback and added a short changelog entry. PTAL when you have a minute — I also added a tiny smoke script in the repo.

maria: checking now, thanks for the ping. will skim the changelog then run the smoke.

deploy-bot: CI: all checks passed on branch feature/routing-fallback-fix (build #482). :white_check_mark:

lee: smoke command (from repo root):
```
./scripts/run_smoke.sh --target=local --profile=quick
```
output snippet: `OK  12/12 checks passed, 0 errors`

anya: nice, looks good to me. left one tiny wording nit in the changelog line about fallback priority. PTAL at my suggestion. overall LGTM. :thumbsup:

lee: fixed the wording and pushed. question for the group: should I squash these followups into the original PR or keep the followups as separate commits to preserve history?

sam: personal preference: squash to keep the PR tidy for release notes, unless anyone needs the intermediate commits for debugging.

maria: +1 to squash, small followups.

lee: alright i'll squash and force-push in a few mins, will also add a short changelog entry to the release notes doc. thanks all!
